verdict.rationale: RustDesk's own docs say Server Pro provides a web console, device groups, a shared address book, and per-user and device-group access control, which covers every element of the story. The pricing page lists the same features (web console, address book, access control). The capability is limited to the paid Server Pro tier, and the evidence is summary-level only. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how group access policies are configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the shared address book and group policy features.

support.subject: As an IT admin, machines and users are organized in a shared address book or console with per-group access policies

citations.quote: Server Pro adds a web console, device groups, a shared address book, per-user and device-group access control, audit logs, and a management API.
